headline: Frontend Developer & UI/UX Designer
shortBio: Frontend Developer passionate about building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Sanity CMS. I enjoy creating clean UI, smooth animations, and scalable frontend architectures.

children.text: Hi, I'm Vijay Negi, a Frontend Developer based in Dehradun, India. I enjoy building fast, responsive, and visually appealing web applications with a strong focus on user experience and clean, maintainable code.

I have professional experience as a Web Designer at Axel Web Technologies, where I developed responsive web interfaces, reusable frontend components, optimized website performance, and collaborated with teams to deliver client-focused solutions. Alongside my professional work, I completed frontend web development training at Brillica Services and continuously enhance my skills by building real-world projects.

My primary tech stack includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Git, GitHub, Framer Motion, GSAP, and Sanity CMS. I am continuously learning modern web technologies and building projects that improve my problem-solving and development skills.
